title: Variance-trajectory artifact (post-corpus-expansion)
description: Strict schema for the variance-trajectory artifact emitted by tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/compute_variance_trajectory.py. Records the cross-cell sample stddev (ddof=1) of the L2 predictor's per-cell predicted_hit_rate values over the admitted cohort, the documented floor stddev (0.10), the precondition status, the LOOCV inputs the calibration-fitting plan will need, and the calibration_application_verdict which this plan always pins to deferred_to_plan_2_per_dec_1.

generator.description: Path or identifier of the tool that emitted this artifact.

cohort_admitted_count.description: Count of admitted cells used to compute cross_cell_stddev.

predicted_l2_hit_rate.description: Raw Smith-Eklund L2 predicted hit rate (NEVER Platt/Isotonic/Beta-adjusted in this plan).

cross_cell_stddev.description: Unbiased sample stddev (ddof=1) of the cells[].predicted_l2_hit_rate values.

documented_floor_stddev.description: The plan-pinned floor below which calibration cannot be applied (the calibration-fitting plan's contract; this plan always defers regardless).

precondition_status.description: satisfied iff cross_cell_stddev >= documented_floor_stddev; not_satisfied otherwise.

heuristic_stddev_projection.description: delta_pred / sqrt(n+1) heuristic projection. Documentation-only; NOT a physical formula.

calibration_application_verdict.description: This plan NEVER applies calibration. This constant is the load-bearing contract.
